title: WTF Prediction Market Soroban Event Schema
description: Canonical Soroban contract event schema consumed by wtf-pm-frontend and indexers for World Trade Factory™ prediction markets.

MarketCreated.name: MarketCreated
MarketCreated.description: Emitted when a new calibrated prediction market is initialized by a market creator.

topics.name: market_id
topics.description: The newly deployed market contract address on Stellar

fields.name: creator
fields.description: Account address of the market creator

fields.name: resolver
fields.description: Designated resolution oracle / authority address

fields.name: alpha_bps
fields.description: Liquidity depth scalar in basis points (10,000 = 1.0x)

fields.name: resolution_deadline
fields.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when trading closes and resolution becomes eligible

fields.name: dispute_window_hours
fields.description: Duration of the challenge window in hours following resolution submission

TradePlaced.name: TradePlaced
TradePlaced.description: Emitted when a trader buys or sells outcome tokens through the calibrated AMM.

fields.name: trader
fields.description: Wallet address of the trader

fields.name: is_yes
fields.description: True if trade is on YES outcome, false for NO outcome

fields.name: collateral_in
fields.description: Collateral tokens exchanged (positive for buy, negative for sell)

fields.name: tokens_out
fields.description: Outcome tokens received (or collateral received on sell)

fields.name: price_impact_bps
fields.description: Calculated price impact in basis points (100 = 1.00%)

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Ledger execution timestamp in Unix seconds

LiquidityAdded.name: LiquidityAdded
LiquidityAdded.description: Emitted when a liquidity provider deposits collateral into the AMM pool.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Address of the liquidity provider

fields.name: collateral_amount
fields.description: Amount of collateral deposited in base units

fields.name: lp_shares_minted
fields.description: Number of LP pool shares issued

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Ledger execution timestamp in Unix seconds

DisputeWindowOpen.name: DisputeWindowOpen
DisputeWindowOpen.description: Emitted when the designated resolver proposes an outcome, starting the challenge window.

fields.name: proposed_outcome
fields.description: Proposed outcome (1 = Yes, 2 = No, 3 = Void)

fields.name: dispute_deadline
fields.description: Unix timestamp when the challenge window expires

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Ledger execution timestamp in Unix seconds

DisputeWindowClosed.name: DisputeWindowClosed
DisputeWindowClosed.description: Emitted when the dispute window lapses without dispute and the outcome is locked.

fields.name: final_outcome
fields.description: Final confirmed outcome (1 = Yes, 2 = No, 3 = Void)

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Ledger execution timestamp in Unix seconds

MarketResolved.name: MarketResolved
MarketResolved.description: Emitted when the market outcome is finalized and winning redemptions are unlocked.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Final winning outcome (1 = Yes, 2 = No, 3 = Void)

fields.name: resolver
fields.description: Address of the resolver who submitted the determination

fields.name: evidence_hash
fields.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte cryptographic hash of resolution evidence

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Ledger execution timestamp in Unix seconds
